text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up: need a compact asset set for next week's benchmark launch :fire: — sparkline microtiles (desktop + mobile), 3 short GIFs (hero motion + loop), and 2 social caption variants. Brand check required. Deadline Wed EOD. @Devin can you pick this up? link: https://drive.mock/brief (placeholder)

Devin (Design): @Maya :wave: Yep. Can you confirm sizes + final model name to call out in copy? Also do we need accessibility alt-text baked into deliverables?

Maya (Marketing): Model name: 'Redwood Latency v1' — use "Redwood Latency" in short captions. Sizes: microtiles 800x800 and 600x600 (carousel + story), hero GIFs 1200x675 and 1080x1080 loops. Alt text required. Also need source SVGs + PNG exports and a 6s GIF loop.

assets-bot: Checklist: [ ] SVG source, [ ] PNG 2x, [ ] GIF 6s loop, [ ] copy variants, [ ] alt text, [ ] brand tokens file. Upload path: /Marketing/Assets/BenchmarkLaunch/

Devin (Design): Ok plan: create 3 concept sketches by Tue noon, iterate Wed morning, final files Wed EOD. Will include two color variants (brand primary + neutral) and one 'dark mode' tile. Any copy language preferences?

Sam (Growth): @Maya Quick ask — for A/B we want CTA variants: 'See the benchmark' vs 'Explore performance'. Keep captions <220 chars. Also request we include a single slide with the cost-per-token sparkline overlay.

Tara (BrandOps): @Devin Tagging brand: please use approved type scale and the new icon lockup. No custom fonts. Also legal: avoid numeric latency claims like 'fastest' unless we have bench note. Use 'low-latency' or 'reduced latency' instead. Ping me for sign-off.

Devin (Design): Noted re: typography and wording. For the GIFs, can we animate only the sparkline + subtle token counter? Example overlay copy (placeholder): `Redwood Latency — reduced per-token time` — we'll swap exact metrics after bench note.

Maya (Marketing): Bench note will land Tue 09:00. If percent confirmed, we update overlays. For now use copy variant A: 'Lower per-token latency for real-time features.' Variant B: 'More throughput, less wait.'

Devin (Design): Uploading initial comps: https://drive.mock/dev/comp1.png :art: Please review. I'll add alt text and export specs in a folder (Figma link forthcoming).

Sam (Growth): :eyes: comps look tight. Request one more CTA 'Try the demo' for paid channels. Also can we get a 9:16 vertical hero for stories?

Tara (BrandOps): Localization heads-up: Spanish + German prioritized. Keep text stems separate in Figma. I'll coordinate phrasing and legal check for localized claims.

Maya (Marketing): Great — confirming final deliverables: SVG + PNG (2 sizes), GIF (6s loop) x3, caption variants (A/B + 'Try the demo'), alt text file, Figma link, color variants, localization placeholders. Delivery target Wed EOD. Thanks team :raised_hands:

assets-bot: Upload reminder scheduled: Wed 18:00 UTC to /Marketing/Assets/BenchmarkLaunch/2145678910/
